To prevent the "Sage Brain" from hallucinating entities, we must anchor the LiDAR data to the
Immutable Truths
of mobile hardware.
SLAM Failures
: Mobile LiDAR (Time-of-Flight) sensors use
Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM)
to build 3D meshes.
Mesh Artifacts
: When a sensor hits a low-texture surface (like a white wall) or a reflective surface, the algorithm often creates jagged "blobs" or "invisible walls".
Logical Anchor
: Under
Work Mode
, any "entity" seen on a LiDAR map that does not correspond to a physical object is classified as a
SLAM Algorithm Failure
, not a "Joker-Pattern".
